description: Kodi addon stack vendored into FOX.TV. Installed into the app's data directory at first run by FanFilmAssetInstaller; the updater compares these versions against the upstream repositories.

addons.notes: The provider itself. Ships its own Kodi shim in lib/fake, which FOX.TV extends.

addons.licence: see LICENSE.txt in the addon tree
addons.notes: Themepack. plugin.video.fanfilm calls xbmcaddon.Addon('script.fanfilm.media').getAddonInfo('path') unguarded in lib/ff/control.py, so a missing themepack raises at import time. Version is pinned to the one required by FanFilm's addon.xml.
Host resolver registry (230 plugins). Imported by lib/ff/sources.py and lib/resolvers/*.
Required by ResolveURL: resolveurl/__init__.py imports kodi_six at module scope, so the registry cannot load without it.
Imported by lib/ff/player.py for adaptive/DRM streams (Helper(protocol, drm=...) / check_inputstream()).

not_bundled.notes: Kodi packages requests as an addon; FOX.TV installs the real wheels instead.
Required by ResolveURL plugins; installed as a wheel.
ResolveURL lazily imports pyqrcode in common.make_qr_file for host device-authorisation QR codes. PyPI ships sdist only, which Chaquopy cannot install, so the BSD-licensed sources are vendored.
Only lib/ff/_requests_types.py imports it, and that module is itself imported under `if TYPE_CHECKING:` in lib/ff/requests.py. Never executed.
Only lib/ff/downloader.py imports it, lazily, for FanFilm's own download-to-disk window. FOX.TV drives source selection through its own SourcePicker, so that window is unreachable.
lib/ff/kodidb.py imports mysql.connector only when the video-database setting is switched to 'mysql'. FOX.TV keeps the sqlite3 default.

not_bundled.provided_by: FoxTv YouTube handling (plugin:// URLs are translated by the bridge)
not_bundled.notes: Declared optional by FanFilm; some providers emit plugin.video.youtube URLs.
Declared optional by FanFilm; FOX.TV has its own binge/next-up flow.
